dogecoin.text:
The lie:
nobody uses #BitcoinCash 

The truth:
yesterday #BCH processed more transactions than #Litecoin, #Monero, #dogecoin, #DASH, #ZCASH, and #DigiByte combined

If the euphoria of the ignorant masses had been steered toward useful projects, #cryptocurrecy would be making meaningful progress improving the world.

That's why it was intentionally directed towards crippled/purposeless projects like #Bitcoin, #dogecoin, #shiba, and #XRP.
